```yaml
name: ADR Audit

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docs/adr/**'
      - '.github/workflows/opentherm-v42-spec-audit.yml'

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check for ADR-044
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "docs/adr/044-webhook-outbound-http-integration.md" ]; then
            echo "::error::ADR-044 (Webhook) is missing. Please add the ADR file."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Check for ADR-045
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "docs/adr/045-ps1-print-summary-parsing.md" ]; then
            echo "::error::ADR-045 (PS=1 parsing) is missing. Please add the ADR file."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify ADR content keywords
        run: |
          echo "Verifying ADR-044 content..."
          grep -q "webhook.ino" docs/adr/044-webhook-outbound-http-integration.md || { echo "::error::ADR-044 must reference webhook.ino"; exit 1; }
          grep -q "isLocalUrl" docs/adr/044-webhook-outbound-http-integration.md || { echo "::error::ADR-044 must reference isLocalUrl"; exit 1; }
          
          echo "Verifying ADR-045 content..."
          grep -q "processPSSummary" docs/adr/045-ps1-print-summary-parsing.md || { echo "::error::ADR-045 must reference processPSSummary"; exit 1; }
          grep -q "PSSUMMARY_MSGIDS" docs/adr/045-ps1-print-summary-parsing.md || { echo "::error::ADR-045 must reference PSSUMMARY_MSGIDS"; exit 1; }

      - name: Success
        run: echo "ADR backlog audit passed."
```
